QUOTE: Gate not defined (the default for outside code): `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `private_##member`. ... Gate defined: `MBEDTLS_PRIVATE(member)` expands to `member`, and the field is reachable under its real name.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that code defining MBEDTLS_ALLOW_PRIVATE_ACCESS sees plain member names, while outside consumers see the renamed `private_` names.
